narr: Monsoonal showers and thunderstorms brought flash flooding and gusty winds to Utah.
ev: The Paria River near Kanab gauge recorded a peak flow of 1270 cfs when the flood wave passed through.
The Escalante River near Escalante gauge recorded a flow increase to 2300 cfs.
Park rangers reported that multiple canyons near the Observation Point area had flash flooding. Time is estimated.

Park rangers reported deep fast flowing water in Buckskin Gulch. The exact details regarding depth of water are not known. Three hour radar estimated precipitation across most of the warned area ranged from 1-2 inches.
A park ranger reported water across Notom Road from Burrow Wash.

The Tooele County emergency manager reported a debris flow from the Jacob City Fire burn scar on county roads near Soldier Creek. Utah Department of Transportation officials also reported mud and rock across state Route 36 following the Flash Flood Warning.

Time is estimated. Homes in Saratoga Springs sustained water damage due to intense bursts of rain, in particular on South Island Road. City parks were also impacted with floodwaters. Construction sites were also affected by rainfall.
